note.question: How can cost-restricted feature selection support data acquisition?
note.overview: When acquiring consumer data for marketing or new business initiatives, it is important to decide what attributes or features of potential customers should be acquired. This paper studies a new feature selection problem in the context of customer data acquisition in which different features have different acquisition costs. This feature selection problem is studied for linear regression and logistic regression.
